title: Can Claude replace Lattice? 17/17 checks, 64 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Lattice alternative, a performance review tool with review cycles, self reviews, peer feedback the manager approves, manager reviews, calibration with a recorded reason and release on a set date, from one written spec: all 17 acceptance checks passed, along with 122 automated tests, and the build exposed 64 gaps in the spec, now fixed.

The core rule is who sees what: the employee sees the manager review and final rating only after release, peer feedback without names and only if at least 2 peers answered, and never the calibration reason.

The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/performance-reviews
Lattice pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/lattice

Lattice prices: Performance $10 per seat per month, Goals & OKRs $8, Engagement $4, billed annually with a $4,000 minimum annual agreement, so a team of up to 33 pays the minimum for Performance alone (lattice.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
